description: Chuong 1: giao lo bon huong, 12 den ON/OFF, 1 buoc = 1 giay. Trang thai gom pha, timer, khung gio hien tai va khung gio chot khi vao pha. Dong ho 24 gio duoc chieu xuong khung gio; cho phep doi khung gio theo cac canh hop le (over-approximation), nen bao toan tinh an toan va song con khi kiem tren moi nhanh. Dong ho chinh xac: smart_intersection_exact.json va smart_intersection.smv. Khong co ham sinh ma, SMT hay fuzzing.
